opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: offers up to £500,000; in special cases, and by prior agreement, up to £750,000. Most grants awarded are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based organisations. Will not fund individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools or further education colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, establishment of academic posts, local charities, or projects led by organisations not based in the UK (except exceptional cases).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK-based organisations. Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year, in Autumn.
